PublicContent.intro: I provide color grading for theatrical films, streaming productions, commercials, and brand films. Both attended and remote sessions are available, with a flexible workflow tailored to each project's scale, schedule, and delivery requirements. I also accept requests for lectures and workshops as a DaVinci Resolve Certified Trainer.

timeline.detail: After graduating from the Faculty of Design at Shizuoka University of Art and Culture, I began my career at IMAGICA as a colorist assistant. Following film telecine work, I developed my grading practice with DaVinci Resolve.

I graded theatrical films, streaming productions, commercials, and music videos. I launched an online-editing and VFX collaboration service built around DaVinci Resolve and introduced the workflow across the department, specializing in ACES color management. As a DaVinci Resolve Certified Trainer, I also taught at broadcasters and Blackmagic Design's headquarters.
Alongside grading, I managed on-set color for LED-wall productions, matching color across different sources and integrating CG, LED backgrounds, and live-action footage naturally.
I established Norikane Film Design Office, continuing to develop structured color-grading methods and education alongside production work.

items.title: Inter BEE 2024 / Imagica EMS Special Day, Makuhari Messe
items.description: Presented The Creative Color Grading: DRAMA at the Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve Theater, demonstrating how to separate dramatic color grading into controllable elements and apply digital relighting.

items.title: Color by IMAGICA: HBO CAS Screening / In-Camera VFX / Grading Demo
items.description: Delivered an in-camera VFX presentation and graded ARRI AMIRA material live at an event co-hosted with ZEISS and the Japanese Society of Cinematographers.

items.title: Virtual Production Experience at FACTORY ANZEN STUDIO
items.description: Participated as a virtual-production color creator, managing real-time color and speaking at a joint press session for the event hosted by Imagica EMS and Japanese cinematography and lighting associations.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve Color Grading Training, Blackmagic Design
items.description: As a DaVinci Resolve Certified Trainer, taught a small-group practical seminar covering conform from other applications, shot matching, and creative grading.

items.title: Hulu drama The Decagon House Murders — An in-camera VFX look
items.description: Worked on set as colorist for the adaptation of Yukito Ayatsuji's novel, collaborating with the lighting department on live correction and on-set grading, including black-level and LED adjustments.

items.title: GEKI×CINE Yoshiwara Gomenjo — Dolby Cinema color
items.description: Created the high-contrast theatrical look for the 20th-anniversary Dolby Cinema release in close discussion with the director.

items.title: GEKI×CINE Rose & Samurai 2 — Dolby Vision grading
items.description: Graded the stage production in Dolby Vision, decomposing the LUT into controllable elements to build a more immersive theatrical look and documenting the process in a case study.

items.title: NHK centennial drama Queen of Mars — VFX production documentary
items.description: Contributed to the VFX and post-production workflow for a drama set on Mars a century in the future, collaborating across departments to realize its visual world.

items.title: Next Generation Workflow — Director
items.description: Directed a presentation film introducing a fully cloud-based workflow from production through finishing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Norikane Film Design Office collects and manages information handled through norikane.studio, its AI consultation desk, and booking flows only for clearly stated purposes necessary to serve projects safely.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect chat messages, booking details, sign-in information, email addresses, company and personal names, reference URLs, cookies and session identifiers, access logs, timestamps, inquiry details, and information about booking changes or cancellations.

sections.title: Purposes of use
sections.body: We use this information to respond to inquiries, organize projects, manage bookings, restore consultation history for signed-in users, improve the service, detect misuse, maintain security, and retain records required by law.

sections.title: Use of AI
sections.body: The AI consultation desk may use AI to help organize project information and communications. AI responses are advisory and do not constitute a formal quotation, contract, delivery guarantee, or final decision.

sections.title: Consultation history and calendar access
sections.body: We use only the signed-in user's previous consultations, bookings, and reference URLs where needed to organize their inquiry. We do not use another user's information in responses. Calendar access is limited to availability; event titles, attendees, and locations are not collected.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Chat logs are deleted automatically seven days after the last message. Booking, inquiry, billing, contract, and legally required records are retained only for the period needed for business or legal purposes.

sections.title: Third parties and external services
sections.body: Except where required by law, we do not provide personal information to third parties without consent. We may use contractors and cloud services for email delivery, calendar integration, authentication, hosting, and data storage.

sections.title: Access, correction, and deletion
sections.body: When a person requests access to, correction of, suspension of use of, or deletion of personal data we hold, we verify their identity and respond in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy may be sent to norikane.satoshi@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern use of norikane.studio and its AI consultation and booking services.

sections.title: Covered services
sections.body: These terms apply to norikane.studio, the AI consultation desk, booking forms, booking-change and cancellation flows, and related email communications operated by Norikane Film Design Office.

sections.title: Role of the AI consultation desk
sections.body: The AI consultation desk helps organize inquiries and bookings. Chat responses and proposed slots are not formal quotations, contracts, delivery guarantees, or commitments to accept work. Conditions become final only after confirmation by Satoshi Norikane.

sections.title: Prohibited conduct
sections.body: You must not submit false information, infringe third-party rights, disclose unnecessary confidential information, attack or gain unauthorized access to systems, send spam, or interfere with the service or other users.

sections.title: Bookings
sections.body: Bookings, changes, and cancellations require separate confirmation. Calendar and AI suggestions indicate possible availability and are not guarantees.

sections.title: Intellectual property and submitted materials
sections.body: Text, images, UI, and other site content belong to us or their legitimate owners. You represent that you hold the rights or permissions needed for materials, reference URLs, and project information you submit. Submitted materials are handled only to respond, review, quote, and manage bookings.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.body: Submitted information is handled for project-related purposes. Do not include confidential, personal, or third-party information beyond what is necessary to organize your inquiry.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of AI responses, suggestions, or availability displays. External-service outages, communications, authentication, or calendar issues may make the service unavailable. Nothing here excludes liability for intentional misconduct, gross negligence, or liability that cannot legally be limited. Final decisions are confirmed by Satoshi Norikane.

sections.title: Confirmation of contract terms
sections.body: Terms such as fees, schedules, cancellation, rights clearance, and confidentiality are governed by the applicable quotation, purchase order, contract, or confirmed email. Chat alone does not determine legal validity or contract terms.

sections.title: Governing law and consultation
sections.body: These terms are governed by Japanese law. If a question or dispute arises, the parties will discuss it in good faith and seek a resolution.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms may be sent to norikane.satoshi@gmail.com.
